events.headline: Enerflex Soars 13% on Gigawatt Data Center Power Award, Backlog Now “Over 1.75 Gigawatts”

lifecycle.authority: Retained structured Lifecycle authority; Markdown and SQLite not read

providers.reason: Enerflex recently secured a massive 1 GW low-emission power contract for a North American data center, boosting its backlog to 1.75 GW. This specific, high-scale exposure to AI infrastructure demand has triggered multiple analyst upgrades and a strong 'gap up' in price, providing significant momentum separate from the broader market volatility.
providers.risk: Short-term technical mean reversion following its 14% single-day spike and potential supply-chain delays in project execution.
